title: Badges
summary: A short non-interactive label for a status, a run's state, a category, a version or a count beside an object, drawn in a size, appearance and colour role or status. It adds no keyboard or pointer behaviour.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

line.description: Takes the text line of this form size, for a table cell or a row of fields, so the row keeps its control height. text takes the line of the text it stands beside: the text's own size and line height, inherited, no block padding, so a count in a contents entry, a tab or a list row is as high as that row's line and one figure is a circle (owner decision C95 point 6).

appearance.description: How the badge looks: tonal (the default, a calm fill of its colour), outline (a mark beside a title: a version, a type), or main, the filled look, which belongs to the attention count alone (with status error). main with any other colour draws tonal; that spelling is noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C140).

scheme.description: Which semantic colour the badge takes. A status word given here still works and reaches the status axis.

status.description: What the badge reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The word this component used before, danger, is still accepted and means error.

activity.description: Where a run stands: running draws a spinner in the icon's place, waiting (needs a person's input), done, stopped, failed, paused (stopped and will go on) and queued (in a queue) an icon of their own, each with its word and colour role. Wins over status and scheme for the icon, the text and the colour; text and icon override it.

icon-only.description: Shows the icon alone, for a tight list row; the text stays as the accessible name and the box closes to a square. Needs an icon to show: without one the text stays visible. The appearance is untouched. The former boolean compact still draws it until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C134: compact means density only; each use noted in SF.deprecations, journal attribute-badge-compact-to-icon-only).

tight.description: Keeps a narrow side room, for dense places: a table, a counter, a chip in a row -- --sf-space-1/3, one space step under the default --sf-space-1/2 (8 · 4 compact · 8 phone; BG-9: the room is a space step, no longer the button's text inset).

type.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

compact.description: Dated alias of icon-only until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C134: compact means density only), still honoured and noted in SF.deprecations.

accessibility.focus: Badge is static metadata and does not enter the tab order.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-badge for a short non-interactive status, category, version or count beside an object.
do_not: Do not use Badge as a button, filter chip or notification
Do not communicate status by colour alone
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
